svg.title: DIA-404 · Rising Tide, Leaky Boats
svg.desc: A flow map of three streams that start at the same width and run from left to right. Past a dashed line where the tool is taken up, each swells: below-average consultants by 43 percent in quality score, developers by 26.08 percent in tasks completed, and above-average consultants by 17 percent. Dashed lines inside each stream keep its width without AI. The three run together into one river and meet a wall labelled the pass. A note beyond it says that what reaches the table is decided there, and that across whole teams delivery stability is still worse where AI use is higher.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 4 · TWO KITCHENS, SAME MENU
Width is the number. Each stream starts at the same width, its own score without AI (dashed). The team finding is an association from a survey of about 5,000.
DIA-404 · The weaker performers gain most at the station, 43% against 17%. What reaches the table is decided past it.
